metadata.equation: τ = kp⊙(q_d − q) + kd⊙(q̇_d − q̇) + G(q)
operations: Franka Panda gravity-compensated joint PD, 32 states: (q, q̇, reference) -> τ
metadata.sampling: 32 states per case; measured and desired q uniform in each joint's range or [-pi, pi], drawn independently so the position error is never small; measured and desired qdot uniform on [-1, 1], drawn independently so the Coulomb feedforward is exercised with the two signs disagreeing; qddot_d uniform on [-1, 1]. Gains are uniform per joint. The Cartesian target is the tool's own pose displaced by a twist uniform on [-0.02, 0.02] m and [-0.05, 0.05] rad. The Franka is edited as the articulated dynamics cases edit it, with joint frictionloss set to [0.3, 0.25, 0.2, 0.18, 0.12, 0.1, 0.08, 0.05, 0.05].
